briefTitle: A Study of JNJ-90301900 in Combination With Chemoradiation Followed by Consolidation Immunotherapy for Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)

typedChecks.sourceText: Have an eastern cooperative oncology group (ECOG) performance status of 0 to 1
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Have an eastern cooperative oncology group (ECOG) performance status of 0 to 1

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Must be a candidate for standard of care (SOC) treatment of non small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) by concurrent platinum-based doublet chemotherapy with radiation therapy (cCRT) followed by consolidation durvalumab treatment as determined by the investigator and per local guidelines at screening
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Investigator discretion and subjective candidacy determination.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have at least 1 target lesion (primary lung lesion or involved lymph node\[s\]) per RECIST version 1.1 that is amenable to intratumoral and/or intranodal injection and intensity modulated radiation therapy (IMRT) as determined by the investigator at screening
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable/target lesion per RECIST and procedural amenability are subjective imaging and investigator-dependent assessments.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Must be a candidate for standard of care (SOC) treatment of non small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) by concurrent platinum-based doublet chemotherapy with radiation therapy (cCRT) followed by consolidation durvalumab treatment as determined by the investigator and per local guidelines at screening
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Candidate determination is based on investigator judgment and local guidelines.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have a medical history of pathologically (histologically or cytologically) proven diagnosis of NSCLC within 3 months prior to enrollment/randomization
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Pathologically proven diagnosis timing is a general condition requirement, not a typed biomarker or histology check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have at least 1 target lesion (primary lung lesion or involved lymph node[s]) per RECIST version 1.1 that is amenable to intratumoral and/or intranodal injection and intensity modulated radiation therapy (IMRT) as determined by the investigator at screening
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Involves RECIST assessment and procedural amenability determined by investigator discretion.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Medical history of: (a) Primary immunodeficiency (b) Organ transplant that requires therapeutic immunosuppression
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Medical history exclusion items for immunodeficiency and organ transplant do not map to allowed typed kinds.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Any of the following within 3 months prior to enrollment/randomization: severe or unstable angina, myocardial infarction, clinically significant ventricular arrhythmias or heart failure New York heart association functional classification class III to IV
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Cardiac history and NYHA functional class criteria are clinical judgments not mapped to typed kinds.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Another concurrent or prior primary malignancy within the last 36 months at informed consent
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior malignancy timeframe is an exclusion condition not matching available typed kinds.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Known allergies, hypersensitivity, or intolerance to any ingredients of JNJ-90301900 crystalline solution, platinum-based doublet chemotherapy (ChT), or durvalumab
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Allergies and hypersensitivities are general exclusion criteria.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: History of coagulation disorders, including: (a) Active bleeding diathesis or requirement for therapeutic anticoagulation or antiplatelet that cannot be interrupted or altered for JNJ-90301900 injection procedures, (b) Major thromboembolic events (for example, pulmonary embolism, cerebrovascular accident) within 3 months of enrollment or randomization
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Coagulation and anticoagulation management depend on procedural flexibility and investigator discretion.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have locally advanced unresectable stage III NSCLC according to the eighth edition lung cancer stage classification
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: deterministic normalizer did not verify this model check
